correctness.rationale: For the Tribonacci fixed point 0→01,1→02,2→0, the 3-pseudoperiod condition for 1≤a<b<c is equivalent to x0∈{xa,xb,xc} for every length-(c+1) factor. Independently generated sigma^15(0) length 10609; for all factor lengths 1..504 the observed factor count is exactly 2m+1, matching the established Tribonacci complexity p(m)=2m+1, hence factors are exhaustive. Independent mismatch-bitset full enumeration for every 1≤a<b<c<504 returned exactly 9352 and cumulative counts at lengths 7,13,24,44,81,149,274,504 of 0,2,9,42,172,676,2402,9352; the nine c<24 triples match the package. The finite check is exhaustive because of the complexity theorem, not merely because a large prefix was sampled.
